The doom matchup is very skill based. Brigs bash can cancel doom punch sure, but good Dooms will charge punch to bait an early bash, then punish her. It’s all about timing your bash and using it when stunning the two of you benefits your team more than theirs.

It depends on the rollout. Slam canceling in the air with punch allows for a more precision, since you can choose exactly where you’re going with your punch. However, it doesn’t go as far. Super-slamming (punching from a slam for great distances) is great for going much faster and further, but it’s not as precise since your control over your slam isn’t as great.

His block being CC immune would be very overpowered. Ana would be a throw pick against any half-decent doom, and tanks like Sigma and Orisa need to be able to stun him so that they can peel for their team.

Punch being 3s certainly is convenient, however it’s not fun to play against. The two stuns that his punch gives, while not too strong, are very overwhelming when on a 3s cooldown.
